steps.title: The daily market dashboard
steps.narration: We open Trendora on its daily dashboard — the after-the-close overview of the whole watched market. At a glance you can read how broad the move is and which leaders are rising to the top.
steps.point_out: The market-breadth tiles and the ranked leaders, plus the setup tally showing zero names marked Actionable while the market is in a cautious, risk-off mood.

steps.title: Every stock, ranked
steps.narration: Next is the stock leaderboard, where every name in the universe is ranked by leadership, each carrying its own entry-quality and risk scores plus a one-line reason. You can sort and filter to zero in on the setups you care about.
steps.point_out: The leadership-sorted table, with the strongest semiconductor names leading the list today.

steps.title: What every label means
steps.narration: The methodology page is Trendora's plain-language glossary: it spells out exactly what each setup and pattern means, with the precise cutoffs read live from the scanner's own configuration so the definitions always match the scores you see.
steps.point_out: Each setup — Actionable, Breakout-watch, Pullback-watch and the rest — shown alongside the live thresholds the scanner actually applies.

steps.title: The data behind every score
steps.narration: Finally, the Data Manager shows the dataset every score is built on — the span of price history, the trading days covered, and the size of the watched universe. From here you can grow the record by fetching fresh prices for a single date or a whole range.
steps.point_out: The coverage grid — and note the universe is reported honestly at its real 122 names, never an inflated or invented count.
